event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Semis cracked, defensive bid, tape on edge.
Nov NY Fed Manufacturing printed 7.8 vs 18 fc (prev 25.5) alongside 6.5% PPI, and the tape sold the growth scare through semis: SOXX -5.41%, XLK -3.24%. Money ran to Staples +0.27% and Utilities +0.18% while QQQ broke its 200-day MA — defensive risk-off confirmed.

INDICES — VIX 22.9, above its 19.6 20-day MA.
SPY -1.91%, IWM -1.66%, DIA -1.43%, QQQ -2.67%, SOXX -5.41% — small beat large by 0.69pp but both fell. Most notable cross-asset: USO -3.81%, silver -3.94%. QQQ is BELOW its 200-day MA — a CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.5x with price down 1.91% = clear distribution; QQQ 0.9x means the index-level selling came without retail participation (watch the gap). SLV 1.5x and SOXX 1.5x are gaining attention on the downside. Breadth diverges: only 65% above 50-DMA, 59% above 200-DMA, advance/decline 145/355, up/down volume 0.26 — narrow, and new 60d highs 48 vs 23 lows doesn't offset the collapse.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLP Staples +0.27%, XLU Utilities +0.18%, XLRE Real Estate -0.27%, XLV Healthcare -0.51%, XLF Financials -0.85%, XLB Materials -1.46%, XLY Discretionary -1.53%, XLC Comms -1.72%, XLI Industrials -1.85%, XLE Energy -1.96%, XLK Technology -3.24%.
Top: JETS +0.62%, KIE +0.61%; bottom: WGMI -6.82%, DRAM -7.38%. Flows contradict price — XLK saw the largest 5d inflow (+$1,536mm, 100th pctile) yet fell hardest, suggesting dip-buying not conviction; XLU and XLE bled (-$510mm, -$455mm) despite outperforming. Rotation call: defensive risk-off — money into Staples/Utilities on relative strength, out of Energy and Tech.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.60, QQQ 1.22, IWM 2.85 = heavy protection demand; skew positive across all three (SPY +13.3%). QQQ IV at 40% is elevated. VIXEQ 46.5 vs VIX 22.9 = wide gap, high dispersion, rotation tape not correlated macro tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -3.81% and silver -3.94% together is a demand-scare signal, not just dollar (UUP +0.20%). Gold -0.71% despite risk-off is unusual — real-yield pressure. Next FOMC Dec 9; CME FedWatch prices 100% hike into that meeting, matching Polymarket's 96% for hike-pause-hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 59.4, Neutral but complacent vs VIX. Movers: MU -7.62%, MRVL -7.27% (semis), TER -7.07%. GS is the standout vol spike (2.3x, -2.73%) — distribution into the Bank 7. Watch tomorrow: SOXX (5.41% drop, 1.5x vol) for capitulation vs continuation into Retail Sales +0.2% fc; GS for financial-sector spillover; SPY 1.5x volume vs QQQ 0.9x divergence as CTA-trigger confirmation.
